sources.title: Wicked Fast Qwen 3.6 27B: 60 tok/s with MTP on RTX 3090 (2026)
sources.snippet: On my RTX 3090, Qwen 3.6 27B Q4_K_M just hit 60 tok/s with MTP — roughly 1.6x faster than the same setup without MTP on mean per-prompt throughput, and 1.86x faster on wall-clock time across nine mixed prompts.
